quarterly_data.quarter: Semtech press release: Semtech Advances Next-Gen AI Optical Interconnects for XPO (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semtech announced its membership in the eXtra-dense Pluggable Optics MSA as a technology partner and detailed its 200G/lane XPO product family of linear modulator drivers and TIAs: GN1834L and GN1834DL quad TIAs, GN1838L and GN1838DL octal TIAs, the GN42T380 octal TIA, TN1877 quad and TN1887 octal Mach-Zehnder Modulator (MZM) drivers, and the GN42M380 octal MZM driver, with on-chip equalization, integrated telemetry and ultra-low latency for high-density AI network switch and fabric applications. Semtech says the portfolio is designed to support XPO 'from early prototyping through volume deployment'; no sampling or availability dates are stated, and the parts are to be demonstrated at ECOC 2026. Per the release, the current XPO generation delivers 12.8T per module at 200G/lane using an integrated liquid-cooling design, with an MSA roadmap to a future generation based on 400G/lane electrical interfaces.
quarterly_data.figure: 200G/lane XPO driver/TIA family; XPO 12.8T per module at 200G/lane, roadmap to 400G/lane
